high_level_description: This image appears to be a screenshot from an Instagram post by the user "shhristii," taken 19 hours prior to the screenshot being captured. She is wearing a light-colored, fluffy coat over a green knitted sweater and a white skirt. Her hair is dark and styled in loose waves.
